problem: An exact released CDC package passed package validation but one retained packaged test failed in a clean consumer layout because it referenced a fixture outside the immutable package tree.

hypotheses.statement: The transported package differed from release.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Compare vendored subtree with release package tree.

hypotheses.statement: A packaged test depends on a canonical-repository fixture outside the package.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Run the suite from a consumer layout and inspect the failing path.
hypotheses.observed_result: The only error was a missing repo-level fault-injection fixture; adding the exact fixture outside the package made all 866 tests pass.

correction: Make retained package regressions self-contained in the next patch line: package required fixtures under the immutable package tree or move such tests to release/bootstrap evidence.
defense_in_depth: Execute the full packaged suite from a synthetic consumer layout containing only declared package/fixture inputs.
invariant: Every test shipped inside CDC executes from a clean vendored consumer layout without undeclared canonical-repository files.
